title: Typed contract
responsibility: Shows component fields, callable APIs and source-declared service or model methods with shared parameter, return and example tables.

inputs.name: EntityContract.unit
inputs.description: The entity at the selected revision, including source-declared model definitions, fields, methods and recorded examples.

inputs.name: EntityContract.category
inputs.description: The kind of entity; config outputs are labelled Provides.

inputs.name: EntityContract.contract
inputs.description: Prepared contract facts such as purpose, route and execution targets.

inputs.name: EntityContract.last
inputs.description: Optional parent commit when the selected revision removed this entity.

outputs.name: EntityContract
outputs.description: Typed component fields or separate callable, service and model method contracts. Models expose actual fields and methods without invented CRUD; declared errors appear once and info controls open full examples.
